cohort: 6501 singleton pregnancies delivering between 41+0 to 43+0 weeks
finding: Induction of labor at >41 weeks gestation resulted in higher rates of emergency Cesarean section due to intrapartum fetal compromise, compared to expectant management.
mod_finding: Induction of labor at >41 weeks gestation resulted in higher rates of emergency Cesarean section due to intrapartum fetal compromise, compared to expectant management.
